title: Audit the real current/docs folder
pattern: keeps copied defaults; proposes no cut at the level of a section or document
expectation: Chosen because current/docs holds long reference pages that copy values the code already states. The claim TTL default 900 (ClaimService.kt:409, AdvanceRequests.kt:154) is copied into workflow-guide.md at about line 1098 and 1122 and fleet-deployment.md at about line 1569, and the page-limit default 50 into api-rest.md at about lines 672, 743 and 815, so a code change leaves every copy stale. Without guidance the audit lists typos and stale details to correct line by line, and proposes no cut at the level of a section or a whole document. A pass reports the copied defaults with a move to state each in one place and point at it, and proposes at least one document-level cut, split or merge. A finding is `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong> | <what to do>`; content terms are matched after the location. The snapshot is the archive of the base sha, one commit, no history.
prompt: Audit current/docs/ against the code and tell me the ten most important problems, in order of importance. Write audit.md with one line per problem, formatted `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong> | <what to do about it>`. Do not edit any other file.
